    Proposition 4.1: the periodic tree model #

    prop:periodic-tree-model, parts (1) and (3): a finite connected stable translation quiver with at most one arrow between two vertices, containing an arrow and carrying a finite-dimensional scalar mesh category, is covered by the repetition ℤΔ of a Dynkin star model Δ; the covering commutes with translation and is surjective. Combined with StarDeck.deck_cyclic, its fibres are the orbits of an infinite cyclic group of translation-commuting automorphisms acting freely.

    The proof assembles Steps 1–4 (SectionalCover, SectionalDynkin, ModelDeck), transporting the covering from the tree of sectional paths to the star model along the isomorphism of Step 2 (ZTransport).

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.
